name: When should I consider repairing my door versus replacing it?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider repairing my door versus replacing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider repairing your door if the damage is localized and minor, such as a loose hinge, a drafty seal, or a faulty lock. Repairs are often more cost-effective for issues that don't compromise the door's structural integrity. Replacement is advisable when the door frame is severely warped, the door itself is extensively damaged, or if upgrading to a more secure or energy-efficient model is a priority. We can help you assess the damage and recommend the best course of action for your situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair is suitable for minor, localized damage like loose hinges or faulty locks. Replace a door if the frame is severely warped, the door is extensively damaged, or if you seek a major upgrade.
